body: Two helicopters collided while landing at the Pheriche helipad in Nepal's Mount Everest region on November 3, 2026, killing one passenger and injuring three people, according to the Solukhumbu District Police Office. The victim was a 47-year-old Indian national from Chennai, Tamil Nadu. The injured were a New Zealand citizen of Indian origin who was traveling on the same helicopter as the victim, and the pilots of both aircraft. Nepal's Civil Aviation Authority said both aircraft were AS350 single-engine helicopters: the Air Dynasty Heli Service helicopter, registered 9N-AOD, had arrived from Tenzing-Hillary Airport in Lukla carrying no passengers, while the Fishtail Air helicopter, registered 9N-AJR, was arriving from Gorakshep with two foreign passengers on board. The report said the helicopters' rotors struck during landing.

No fire broke out after the impact, and the cause remained undetermined with an investigation underway. The three injured people were evacuated by air for medical treatment, and the victim's body was flown to Lukla ahead of a planned transfer to Kathmandu for a post-mortem examination. Pheriche sits at approximately 4,200 meters above sea level along the main trekking route to Everest base camp, and with no road access to much of the Khumbu region, helicopters provide passenger transfers, deliver supplies, and evacuate trekkers suffering from altitude sickness or exhaustion. The report also noted longstanding concerns over helicopter safety in Nepal, citing a high-level government committee report published in late 2025 that recorded 40 helicopter crashes and 92 fatalities over 63 years of helicopter operations in the country and concluded that efforts to strengthen safety oversight had fallen short of expectations.
en.summary: Two helicopters collided while landing at the Pheriche helipad in Nepal's Mount Everest region, killing one passenger and injuring three people; the cause remains under investigation.
en.title: Two helicopters collide near Mount Everest, killing passenger

body: 尼泊爾索盧昆布地區警方表示，11月3日兩架直升機在聖母峰地區費里切直升機停機坪著陸時相撞，造成1名乘客死亡、3人受傷。罹難者為47歲、來自印度清奈的印度籍人士；傷者包括與罹難者搭乘同一架直升機、具印度裔背景的紐西蘭籍人士，以及兩架直升機的飛行員。尼泊爾民航局表示，兩架直升機均為AS350單引擎直升機；其中，Air Dynasty Heli Service的直升機註冊編號為9N-AOD，自盧卡拉的丹增希拉蕊機場抵達，未載運乘客，而Fishtail Air的直升機註冊編號為9N-AJR，自戈拉克雪普抵達，載有2名外籍乘客。報導指出，兩架直升機的旋翼在著陸時發生碰撞。

撞擊後未發生火災，事故原因尚未確定，調查正在進行中。3名傷者已由空中後送就醫，罹難者遺體先運往盧卡拉，預定再轉送加德滿都進行驗屍。費里切海拔約4,200公尺，位於前往聖母峰基地營的主要健行路線沿線；昆布地區多無道路通行，直升機負責載運乘客、運送物資，並後送出現高山症狀或體力透支的健行者。報導也提到尼泊爾直升機安全長期受到關注：尼泊爾文化、旅遊暨民航部高層委員會於2025年底公布的報告記載，尼泊爾直升機營運63年來共發生40起墜機事故、造成92人死亡，委員會認為強化安全監督的努力未達預期。
